$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/planning.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office (and the worker and scheduler, in the tenant's system context: the nightly planning run) writes the planning settings, item parameters, line and work-centre capacity, pegging and exceptions through apps/factory-api's modules/planning (B-W2a-16, B-W2a-22), always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies and sites their grants reach. Office only: the floor sees nothing of the plan until the planning board publishes it (Owner answer P3; the published plan is wave 5's), and portal and link sessions read nothing. No table holds a price, cost or a person's figure (capacity and efficiency are per line and work centre: Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4). RequirementPegging is append-only (`@append-only`; the …_stock_plan_w2a_guards triggers refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login). Nobody deletes settings, capacity or an exception (they are changed or resolved); the office deletes an item's parameters, which then fall back to the item's defaults. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

PlanningSettings.about: The office sets a site's planning horizon, buckets, default efficiency and nightly run time (one row per site, its id the site's). Office only.

ItemPlanning.about: The office sets how a site plans an item: method, source, lead times, safety stock, reorder point, min/max and lot sizes; it removes a row to plan the item by its defaults again. Office only.

LineCapacity.about: The office sets a line's planned efficiency and the people it plans with (one row per line, its id the line's). Office only: per line, never per person.

WorkCentreCapacity.about: The office sets a work centre's planned units and efficiency (one row per work centre, its id the work centre's). Office only.

RequirementPegging.about: A planning run writes the pegging of its requirements; the office reads it (Why, the pegging tree, material readiness). Nobody changes or removes a row.

PlanningException.about: A planning run raises, moves on and clears exceptions; the office acknowledges, snoozes, assigns and resolves them. Office only.
